title: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
title_zh: Can LLMs在无代码的情况下解决问题？

paragraphs.en: Context. A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow, rather than by modifying the source code. Bug reports frequently admit such fixes, but manually verifying whether a proposed no-code fix genuinely resolves the reported bug consumes considerable developer time that could otherwise go toward core development work.
paragraphs.zh: 背景。 无需代码的解决方案通过指导用户更改设置、升级到已修复该问题的版本或调整其工作流程来解决无效的缺陷报告，而不是修改源代码。 缺陷报告中经常提到此类解决方案，但手动验证所提出的无需代码的解决方案是否真正解决了所报告的缺陷，会消耗大量开发时间，而这些时间本可用于核心开发工作。

paragraphs.en: Objective. This study proposes and evaluates an automated pipeline for the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes, replacing manual verification with execution-based evaluation in a real browser environment.
paragraphs.zh: 目标。 本研究提出并评估了一种自动化流程，用于检验大型语言模型（LLM）生成无需代码的修复方案的能力，以基于执行的实际浏览器环境评估取代人工验证。

sents.en: Objective.
sents.zh: 目标。

sents.en: This study proposes and evaluates an automated pipeline for the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes, replacing manual verification with execution-based evaluation in a real browser environment.
sents.zh: 本研究提出并评估了一种自动化流程，用于检验大型语言模型（LLM）生成无需代码的修复方案的能力，以基于执行的实际浏览器环境评估取代人工验证。

paragraphs.en: Method. We evaluate 322 no-code fixes generated by the 12 LLM-based configurations released with the benchmark of a previous study. From this benchmark, we select the bug reports categorized as Faulty Configuration, Wrong Version, or External System & Dependency. For each report, evaluation proceeds through an execution pipeline in which an executor agent applies each fix by following its natural-language instructions in a real browser environment, and an issue-specific checker determines whether the reported bug persists. We repeat the full pipeline with three executors from different providers: two Computer-Use Agents (CUAs), OpenCUA-72B and Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 with computer use, and one multimodal agentic LLM, Meta’s Muse Glimmer, to characterize how much the choice of executor affects the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们评估了先前研究基准中发布的 12 种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的配置所生成的 322 个无代码修复方案。 我们从该基准中筛选出被归类为“配置错误”、“版本错误”或“外部系统与依赖项”的缺陷报告。 对于每份报告，评估通过一个执行流程进行：执行智能体按照自然语言指令在真实浏览器环境中应用每个修复方案，而针对特定问题的检查器则判断所报告的缺陷是否仍然存在。 我们使用来自不同提供商的三个执行者重复整个流程：两个计算机使用智能体（CUA），即 OpenCUA-72B 和 Anthropic 的 Claude Sonnet 5（具备计算机使用能力），以及一个多模态智能体大型语言模型 Meta 的 Muse Glimmer，以分析执行者的选择对结果的影响程度。

paragraphs.en: Results. 17.6% of the candidate issues could be set up in the environment and passed both sanity gates, and the remaining issues could not be reproduced. Across the 322 fixes 14.6% to 49.7% resolved the bug depending on the executor, and the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 in the Vanilla pipeline, resolved up to 74.1% of its fixes under the executor Claude Sonnet 5. Changing only the executor shifted a configuration’s resolution rate by 38.8% on average, and the three executors reached the same verdict on only 46.9% of the fixes. Compared with human execution, the executors matched the outcome on which two human executors agreed for 66.1% to 88.1% of the sampled fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。17.6% 的候选问题能够在环境中成功设置并通过所有合理性检查，而其余问题则无法复现。 在 322 个修复中，根据执行器的不同，修复问题的比例介于 14.6% 到 49.7% 之间；其中，Vanilla 流程中最强的配置（Claude Opus 4.6）在 Claude Sonnet 5 执行器下成功解决了多达 74.1% 的修复问题。 仅更换执行器便使某项配置的解决率平均变化了 38.8%，而三种执行器在所有修复中仅有 46.9% 的情况得出了相同的判断结果。 与人工执行相比，在抽样测试的修复中，执行器与人一致匹配结果的占比为 66.1% 到 88.1%。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion. Even under the best executor, fewer than half of the LLM-generated no-code fixes resolve the reported bug, so such fixes need verification before they reach users. Execution-based verification can provide this without manual inspection, but the measured capability depends strongly on the executor, which evaluations must therefore report and control.
paragraphs.zh: 结论。 即使在最佳执行器的情况下，由大型语言模型生成的无代码修复方案中，能解决所报告问题的也不到一半，因此这类修复方案在交付给用户前需要经过验证。 基于执行的验证无需人工检查即可实现这一点，但实际测得的能力在很大程度上取决于执行器，因此评估必须对此进行报告和控制。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become part of everyday software engineering practice. They now assist developers across the software development lifecycle, powering code generation ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) , automated code review ( Pornprasit and Tantithamthavorn, 2024 ; Cihan et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , test generation ( Schäfer et al., 2023 ; Celik and Mahmoud, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and bug triage ( Du et al., 2024 ; Aracena et al., 2024 ; Colavito et al., 2025 ) . As these systems move from research prototypes into tools developers rely on daily ( Stack Overflow, 2025 ) software engineering tasks, they are increasingly applied not only to writing and analyzing code, but to the surrounding work of managing the issues that software projects accumulate ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已迅速成为日常软件工程实践的一部分。 如今，它们在整个软件开发生命周期中为开发者提供支持，用于代码生成（Jiang 等，2026；Zhang 等，2023；Jiang 等，2024）、自动化代码审查（Pornprasit 和 Tantithamthavorn，2024；Cihan 等，2025；Yu 等，2024）、测试生成（Schäfer 等，2023；Celik 和 Mahmoud，2025；Zhang 等，2024）以及问题分类（Du 等，2024；Aracena 等，2024；Colavito 等，2025）。 随着这些系统从研究原型转变为开发者日常依赖的工具（Stack Overflow，2025），它们在软件工程任务中的应用已不再局限于编写和分析代码，还越来越多地扩展到处理软件项目积累的各类问题（Jimenez 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: One of the most time-consuming parts of that work is triaging bug reports, and in particular dealing with reports that turn out not to require a code change at all ( Gon et al., 2026 ) . A bug report is invalid when it does not describe a defect in the source code: the reported behavior instead stems from user misconfiguration, an outdated version, a conflicting extension, or a misunderstanding of intended behavior, or the report is not considered as a bug report at all, such as a feature request or a question. Such reports make up a substantial share of what projects receive ( Fan et al., 2018 ; Herzig et al., 2013 ) : a manual inspection of more than 7,000 reports across five open-source projects found that 33.8% of those filed as bugs were misclassified ( Herzig et al., 2013 ) . Rather than with a patch, many invalid reports are resolved by directing the reporter to adjust a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or disable a conflicting extension. Following Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) , we call such a resolution a no-code fix . Triage already consumes a large fraction of maintenance effort, and invalid reports add to that burden without leading to a code change: in an industrial case study, Laiq et al. ( Laiq et al., 2022 ) found that 14 to 17% of submitted reports were invalid, yet these took roughly 16 to 18 calendar days to resolve on average, about as long as valid reports despite requiring no code change. A maintainer must still read the report, reproduce or investigate the problem, determine that no code fix is needed, and explain the resolution to the reporter ( Xuan et al., 2014 ; Gon et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作中最耗时的部分之一是分类处理错误报告，尤其是那些最终被证明完全不需要代码更改的报告（Gon 等，2026）。 当一个错误报告没有描述源代码中的缺陷时，它就是不有效的：此时报告中的行为实际上源于用户的配置错误、版本过旧、扩展程序冲突或对预期行为的误解；或者该报告根本不被视为错误报告，例如功能请求或问题咨询。 这类报告在项目收到的报告中占相当大比例（Fan 等，2018；Herzig 等，2013）：对五个开源项目中超过 7,000 份报告的manual检查发现，被标记为错误的报告中有 33.8% 被错误分类（Herzig 等，2013）。 许多无效报告并非通过补丁解决，而是通过指导报告者调整设置、更新到已修复该问题的版本，或禁用冲突的扩展程序来解决。遵循 Gön 等 （Gon 等，2026）的研究，我们将此类解决方案称为“无需代码的修复”。 分类处理本身已经消耗了维护工作的很大一部分，而无效报告则进一步加重了这一负担，却并未带来任何代码更改：在一项工业案例研究中，Laiq 等 （Laiq 等，2022）发现，提交的报告中 14% 到 17% 是无效的，但这些报告平均需要 16 到 18 个日历日才能解决，与有效报告的解决时间大致相同，尽管它们根本不需要代码更改。 维护者仍然必须阅读报告、重现或调查问题、确定无需代码修复，并向报告者解释解决方案（Xuan 等，2014；Gon 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) introduced a benchmark of invalid Brave 1 1 1 https://brave.com/ browser bug reports, subclassify them by root cause, and generate no-code fixes for them with several LLM configurations, the same benchmark and fixes we evaluate in this paper. Evaluating such fixes is hard. The only reference is the maintainer’s resolution, a free-form comment written for one reporter in one situation, so two fixes can be worded differently while doing the same thing, or worded almost identically while one points to a setting that does not exist. Their study therefore relies on text similarity and an LLM judge, the usual fallbacks when an output cannot be checked by running it ( Torun et al., 2026b ) . Their BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) values fall within a narrow band of 0.81 to 0.82 across all models and configurations, and the LLM judge, while more discriminative, inherits the documented biases of LLM judges ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . Neither shows whether a fix would work if a user followed it (Section 5.2 revisits this on the fixes we execute). This is the gap we address. Execution offers an alternative. A code patch either passes the test suite or not, and Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) have extended this principle to code review by turning review comments into executable tests. A no-code fix produces no code change, but its instructions can still be carried out: changing a setting or disabling an extension is an action in a real environment, after which the reported symptom either persists or disappears. Our goal is therefore to evaluate LLM-generated no-code fixes by whether they actually resolve the reported problem, not by whether they resemble a fix that did. Recent Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) make this process practical to automate, since they interpret natural-language instructions and act on a real interface, which is exactly what applying a no-code fix requires.

paragraphs.en: Building on this observation, we design an automated, execution-based pipeline for evaluating no-code fixes. For each bug report, the pipeline first applies the maintainer’s fix and then rolls it back, which yields a verified fixed state and, from it, a verified buggy state; it then applies a candidate fix to the buggy state and checks whether the bug persists afterwards. Every candidate fix is applied by an executor agent directly from its natural-language text and verified by a deterministic, issue-specific checker; the bug-specific parts of the pipeline are confined to setting up each issue’s environment and its checker. We run it with three executors (Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , OpenCUA-72B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Meta Muse Glimmer ( Meta Superintelligence Labs, 2026 ) ) from different providers and validate the automated verdicts against humans performing the same procedure by hand. paragraphs.en: RQ1: How effectively do agentic executors resolve LLM-generated no-code fixes? We measure the fix-generation capability of 12 LLM-based configurations by executing their fixes end-to-end, reporting resolution and applicability rates overall and broken down by bug subclass.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：智能体执行者在解决 LLM 生成的无代码修复方案时，效果如何？ 我们通过端到端执行 12 种基于 LLM 的配置所生成的修复方案，来衡量其修复生成能力，并报告整体以及按错误子类别划分的解决率和适用率。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a rollback-based, execution-driven pipeline for evaluating LLM-generated no-code fixes. Two sanity gates confirm that the bug is absent once the maintainer’s fix is applied and present once it is rolled back, so every candidate fix runs on a verified buggy state and is judged by whether it removes the bug.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于回滚、以执行为驱动的流程，用于评估 LLM 生成的无代码修复方案。 两道合理性检查确保：在应用维护者修复后问题消失，而在回滚后问题重现；因此每个候选修复方案都在已验证的问题状态上运行，并依据其能否消除问题来判断有效性。

sents.en: We introduce a rollback-based, execution-driven pipeline for evaluating LLM-generated no-code fixes.
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种基于回滚、以执行为驱动的流程，用于评估 LLM 生成的无代码修复方案。

sents.en: Two sanity gates confirm that the bug is absent once the maintainer’s fix is applied and present once it is rolled back, so every candidate fix runs on a verified buggy state and is judged by whether it removes the bug.
sents.zh: 两道合理性检查确保：在应用维护者修复后问题消失，而在回滚后问题重现；因此每个候选修复方案都在已验证的问题状态上运行，并依据其能否消除问题来判断有效性。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the pipeline with agentic executors that apply each natural-language fix directly, verified by issue-specific state check, and we compare three executors, two CUAs and one multimodal agentic LLM, to quantify the effect of executor choice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过智能体执行器来实例化该流程，这些执行器能够直接应用每种自然语言修复方案，并通过针对具体问题的状态检查进行验证；同时，我们比较了三种执行器——两种CUA和一种多模态智能体LLM——以量化执行器选择所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 322 individual no-code fixes (12 LLM-based configurations × \times three generation runs × \times nine reproducible bug reports, of which two generations are missing from the source benchmark), reporting per-configuration resolution and applicability rates at the level of individual fixes and their variation across bug subclasses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 322 个独立的无代码修复方案（12 种基于 LLM 的配置 × \times 三次生成运行 × \times 九个可复现的缺陷报告，其中源基准测试中缺少两次生成结果），并报告了每个配置在单个修复方案层面的解决率和适用率，以及这些指标在不同缺陷子类中的差异。

paragraphs.en: We compare the automated verdicts with human execution of the same fixes, indicating how far each executor’s verdicts can be trusted and in which direction they diverge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将自动化判决与人类执行相同修复方案的结果进行了比较，以此说明每位执行者的判决在多大程度上值得信赖，以及它们存在哪些方向的差异。

( Herzig et al., 2013 ) manually examined more than 7,000 issue reports across five open-source projects and found that 33.8% were misclassified: they did not point to a defect but requested a new feature, a documentation update, or an internal refactoring, introducing measurable bias into downstream bug-prediction studies. Distinguishing such reports from genuine defects has since become a task in its own right, studied extensively before the arrival of LLMs. Antoniol et al. ( Antoniol et al., 2008 ) and Zanetti et al. ( Zanetti et al., 2013 ) used text-based and social-network features, respectively, to separate genuine bugs from other change requests; Fan et al. ( Fan et al., 2018 ) , Otoom et al. ( Otoom et al., 2019 ) , and Pandey et al. ( Pandey et al., 2017 ) trained SVM and random-forest classifiers for the same task, with Fan et al. identifying textual content and submitter experience as the strongest predictors. Meng and Visser ( Meng and Visser, 2023 ) fine-tuned BERT to classify and explain bug report validity, and Laiq et al. ( Laiq et al., 2025 ) compared classical and transformer-based models on a unified benchmark, finding fine-tuned RoBERTa to perform best. Du et al. ( Du et al., 2024 ) propose LLM-BRC, a large-language-model–based framework for bug report classification; Aracena et al. ( Aracena et al., 2024 ) and Colavito et al. ( Colavito et al., 2025 ) likewise apply and benchmark LLMs for automated issue labeling. Closer to our setting, Dinç and Tüzün ( Dinç and Tüzün, 2025 ) apply a range of LLM and machine-learning methods specifically to the valid/invalid distinction, characterizing where LLMs succeed and fail at this classification.

paragraphs.en: Once a report is identified as invalid, resolving it typically requires no patch, only an explanation of a configuration change, a version update, or a workaround. This is what we call a no-code fix. Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) introduce a benchmark of invalid Brave browser issues, subclassify them by root cause, and generate no-code fixes for them using 12 LLM-based configurations (Section 3.2 ). We build directly on this benchmark (Section 3.1 ). Torun et al. ( Torun et al., 2026a ) situate this task within a broader vision for artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted bug tracking, in which incoming reports are automatically triaged as valid or invalid, invalid reports are resolved by agent-suggested no-code fixes, and valid ones proceed to patch generation and human review. Our work can be read as an empirical test of whether the no-code-fix step of that vision is achievable with current LLMs. Where prior work ( Gon et al., 2026 ) in this space evaluates generated fixes by comparing them to a reference resolution, we evaluate by execution: applying each fix to a live environment and checking whether the reported bug persists.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦一份报告被认定为无效，解决它通常不需要打补丁，只需解释配置变更、版本更新或替代方案即可。 这就是我们所说的无代码修复。Gön 等人 （Gon 等人，2026）引入了一项针对 Brave 浏览器无效问题的基准测试，按根本原因对其进行子分类，并使用 12 种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的配置（第 3.2 节）为其生成无代码修复方案。 我们直接基于这项基准测试进行构建（第 3.1 节）。Torun 等人 （Torun 等人，2026a）将这一任务置于人工智能（AI）辅助缺陷跟踪的更广泛愿景中：新收到的报告会被自动分类为有效或无效；无效报告通过智能体建议的无代码修复得到解决；而有效报告则进入补丁生成和人工审核流程。 我们的工作可被视作一项经验性测试，旨在验证该愿景中的无代码修复步骤是否能在当前大型语言模型（LLM）的支持下实现。 与此领域先前的研究（Gon 等人，2026）不同——后者通过比较生成的修复方案与参考解决方案来评估其有效性——我们的评估基于实际执行：将每个修复方案应用于真实环境，并检查所报告的缺陷是否仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work uses LLMs and agents to interact with running software. Kang et al. ( Kang et al., 2024 ) prompt LLMs to generate bug-reproducing tests directly from natural-language bug reports and evaluate 15 models on the Defects4J benchmark, reproducing roughly one third of the included bugs; their technique, like later agentic approaches ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , operates at the level of unit tests rather than a live GUI. Feng and Chen ( Feng and Chen, 2024 ) instead target a live GUI directly: their AdbGPT system prompts an LLM to extract steps-to-reproduce from an Android bug report and replays them as GUI events on the device without any bug-specific scripting, closer in spirit to how our pipeline executes steps-to-reproduce in a browser. Closer to our environment, Yapağcı et al. ( Yapağcı et al., 2025 ) introduce BugCraft, which uses an LLM to synthesize steps-to-reproduce from a Minecraft crash report and a vision-based agent to execute them in the game, reproducing 34.9% of crash bugs end-to-end and outperforming baseline computer-use agents by 37%; our sanity checks follow the same execute-steps-and-observe-the-outcome principle, applied to a browser instead of a game. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2025 ) take a complementary retrieval-augmented approach, using bug reports from similar Android apps to guide GUI exploration toward paths likely to trigger a bug, again treating a bug report as an executable specification for an agent.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项独立的研究利用 LLM 和智能体与正在运行的软件进行交互。Kang 等人 （Kang 等人，2024）让 LLM 直接从自然语言错误报告中生成用于复现错误的测试，并在 Defects4J 基准上评估了 15 个模型，成功复现了约三分之一的错误；他们的方法与后续的智能体方法（Cheng 等人，2025；Guo 等人，2026）类似，都是在单元测试层面操作，而非在实时 GUI 层面。 Feng 和 Chen（Feng 和 Chen，2024）则直接针对实时 GUI：他们的 AdbGPT 系统会提示 LLM 从 Android 错误报告中提取复现步骤，并在设备上以 GUI 事件的形式执行这些步骤，无需任何针对特定错误的脚本编写；这种方法在理念上更接近我们的流程如何在浏览器中执行复现步骤。 与我们的环境更为接近的是 Yapağcı 等人 （Yapağcı 等人，2025）提出的 BugCraft 系统，该系统利用 LLM 从 Minecraft 崩溃报告中合成复现步骤，并通过一个基于视觉的智能体在游戏内执行这些步骤，成功端到端复现了 34.9% 的崩溃错误，并比基准计算机操作智能体的表现高出 37%；我们的合理性检查遵循相同的“执行步骤并观察结果”原则，只是将其应用于浏览器而非游戏。Chen 等人 （Chen 等人，2025）采用了一种互补的检索增强方法，利用来自类似 Android 应用中的错误报告来指导 GUI 探索，从而找到更可能触发错误的路径；这种方法同样将错误报告视为智能体可执行的规范。

paragraphs.en: The work closest to ours is Fixpad++ ( İr et al., 2026 ) , which verifies whether a candidate patch fixes a reported crash in the GUI-based Notepad++ editor: a multi-agent system reproduces the bug via an extended ReAct loop with self-reflection, then replays the same trajectory on the patched build to judge fix correctness. Fixpad++ and our pipeline share the core idea of verifying a fix by re-executing a reproduction trajectory rather than by comparing text, but differ in what is being verified and how: Fixpad++ judges source-code patches with a purpose-built multi-agent architecture tuned to a single application. We instead judge natural-language no-code fixes with off-the-shelf agentic executors, both open-weight and proprietary, and treat the choice of executor itself as an independent variable (RQ2).
paragraphs.zh: 与我们工作最接近的是 Fixpad++（İr et al., 2026），它验证候选补丁是否修复了基于 GUI 的 Notepad++ 编辑器中报告的崩溃问题：一个多智能体系统通过带有自我反思的扩展 ReAct 循环重现该错误，然后在已打补丁的版本上重播相同的轨迹以判断修复的正确性。 Fixpad++ 和我们的流程共享一个核心思想：通过重新执行错误重现轨迹来验证修复，而非通过文本比较；但两者在验证对象和验证方式上有所不同：Fixpad++ 使用专为单一应用程序优化的多智能体架构来评估源代码补丁。 我们则使用现成的智能体执行器（包括开源和专有执行器）来评估自然语言形式的无代码修复，并将执行器的选择本身视为一个独立变量（RQ2）。

paragraphs.en: Agent-based verification of GUI artifacts has also been studied outside the bug-fixing setting. Kolthoff et al. ( Kolthoff et al., 2025 ) introduce GUISpector, which uses a multi-modal LLM agent, built on a commercial CUA, to autonomously verify whether a GUI prototype satisfies natural-language requirements and to report which acceptance criteria are met or violated; unlike Fixpad++ and our pipeline, GUISpector checks conformance to a specification, not whether a previously observed bug has disappeared. Closer to our concern with executor reliability, Hong et al. ( Hong et al., 2026 ) show that GUI-agent evaluators frequently misattribute their own execution failures to genuine software defects, and propose reusing a failed trajectory to disambiguate the two; this distinction between evaluator error and actual software defect is precisely what our sanity checks and our RQ3 human-comparison are designed to control for in our own pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体对 GUI 工件的验证研究也已在非故障修复的场景中展开。Kolthoff 等人 （Kolthoff 等人，2025）提出了 GUISpector，该工具使用一个基于商用 CUA 构建的多模态 LLM 智能体，能够自主验证 GUI 原型是否满足自然语言需求，并报告哪些验收标准被满足或违反；与 Fixpad++ 和我们的流程不同，GUISpector 检查的是对规格的符合性，而非先前观察到的故障是否已消失。 更贴近我们对执行器可靠性的关注的是 Hong 等人 （Hong 等人，2026）指出，GUI 智能体评估器经常将其自身的执行失败错误地归因于真实的软件缺陷，并提议复用一次失败的执行轨迹以区分这两种情况；这种评估器错误与真实软件缺陷之间的区分，正是我们的合理性检查以及 RQ3 中的人类对比环节旨在控制的因素。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating LLM-based software engineering tools reliably is difficult in its own right. Torun et al. ( Torun et al., 2026b ) survey current evaluation practices and argue that the open-endedness and non-determinism of LLM outputs undermine the single-ground-truth, deterministic assumptions that conventional SE evaluation relies on. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) alongside BERTScore to grade generated no-code fixes, is itself the subject of active scrutiny: He et al. paragraphs.en: Unlike execution-free critics ( Yadavally et al., 2025 ) , execution-based evaluation sidesteps this problem directly, and it has an established track record for LLM-generated code. SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and SWE-bench-Live ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) evaluate whether a model’s patch to a real codebase makes a GitHub issue’s associated tests pass, instead of scoring the patch’s similarity to a reference diff. The same execution-based principle has recently been extended from source code to the GUI: OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) scores agents on 369 real desktop and web tasks by checking the resulting operating-system state against a task-specific verification script, and WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) evaluates web agents on self-hosted, fully functional websites by checking the functional correctness of the completed task. Our pipeline borrows this state-based checking but inverts the role of the agent: in OSWorld and WebArena the agent is the subject under evaluation, whereas here the agentic executor is part of the measurement instrument and the subject is the LLM-generated no-code fix it applies. This is why we treat the executor as an experimental variable (RQ2) and validate it against human execution (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 与无需执行的批评方法（Yadavally 等人，2025）不同，基于执行的评估直接绕开了这个问题，并且对于 LLM 生成的代码而言，它已有成熟的实践记录。 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）和 SWE-bench-Live（Zhang 等人，2026a）通过判断模型对真实代码库的补丁是否能使 GitHub 问题相关的测试通过来进行评估，而不是根据补丁与参考差异的相似性进行评分。 同样的基于执行的原则最近已从源代码扩展到了 GUI：OSWorld（Xie 等人，2024）通过对比生成的操作系统状态与特定任务的验证脚本，对智能体在 369 项真实桌面和网页任务上的表现进行评分；而 WebArena（Zhou 等人，2024）则通过在自托管的、功能完整的网站上检查已完成任务的功能正确性，来评估网页智能体的表现。 我们的流程借鉴了这种基于状态的检查方法，但反转了智能体的角色：在 OSWorld 和 WebArena 中，智能体是被评估的对象，而在此处，智能体执行器是测量工具的一部分，被评估的对象则是 LLM 生成的无需代码的修复方案及其应用过程。 正因如此，我们将执行器视为一个实验变量（研究问题 2），并通过与人类执行结果的对比来验证它（研究问题 3）。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the dataset we work with, the rollback-based evaluation pipeline shown in Figure 1 , the use of three agentic executors as pipeline executors, and the metrics we report.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了我们使用的数据集、图1所示的基于回滚的评估流程、作为流程执行器的三种智能体执行器，以及我们所报告的指标。

paragraphs.en: We reuse the benchmark released by Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) , which contains 302 annotated bug reports drawn from the Brave browser GitHub issue tracker. Each report is annotated with an invalid-bug-report subclass and, where available, a link to the maintainer comment containing the successful no-code fix. Of the 302 reports, 188 fall into one of seven invalid subclasses, while the remaining 114 are outliers that the original annotation placed outside the taxonomy (reports found to be valid, internal developer-workflow items, or cases with too little information to classify). The benchmark also includes no-code fixes generated by 12 LLM-based configurations for each bug report, spanning four pipeline variants and six backbone LLMs; we describe these configurations in detail in Section 3.2 . Each configuration was executed three times in the original study to account for LLM stochasticity, yielding 36 candidate no-code fixes per bug report (12 configurations × \times three runs), all of which we evaluate independently in our pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重用了 Gön 等人发布的基准数据集。 （Gon 等人，2026），该数据集包含从 Brave 浏览器 GitHub 问题追踪器中抽取的 302 份已标注的缺陷报告。 每份报告都标注了一个“无效缺陷报告”子类，并在有可用信息时，还附上了指向维护者评论的链接，其中包含了成功实现的无需代码的修复方案。 在这 302 份报告中，有 188 份属于七个无效子类之一，而其余 114 份则是原始标注中置于分类体系之外的异常报告（这些报告被判定为有效、属于内部开发者工作流程事项，或信息量太少无法分类）。 该基准数据集还包含了针对每份缺陷报告由 12 种基于大语言模型（LLM）的配置生成的无需代码的修复方案，涵盖了四种流程变体和六种核心 LLM；我们在第 3.2 节中详细描述了这些配置。 在原始研究中，每种配置都执行了三次以考虑 LLM 的随机性，从而为每份缺陷报告生成了 36 个候选的无需代码修复方案（12 种配置 × 三次运行），我们在自己的流程中对所有这些方案进行了独立评估。

paragraphs.en: Agentic Web Search. Follows a WebThinker-style “Think-Search-and-Draft” architecture: the backbone LLM first drafts a research brief, then a bounded orchestration loop issues queries against the Serper Search API. The canonical original-issue page is excluded from results to prevent leakage, and the content of any visited page is compressed before being returned. Retrieved evidence is passed back to the LLM in chronological order before it produces the final classification and fix. Instantiated with Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (paired with Gemini 2.5 Flash for the search loop) and Kimi K2.5.

A further branch, based on whether the ground-truth fix is a version update or a GUI-level change, determines how that fix is applied and rolled back. We describe each stage in turn, following Figure 1 left to right.
paragraphs.zh: 主流程由两个健全性检查括起来，并通过一次显式的状态回滚分隔开。 另一个分支则根据真实修复方案是版本更新还是 GUI 级别的更改来决定该修复方案如何应用和回滚。 我们将按照图 1 从左到右的顺序依次描述每个阶段。

paragraphs.en: For each bug report, we classify the maintainer’s ground-truth fix as version-type (the bug is resolved simply by moving to a newer Brave release) or GUI-type (the bug is resolved by a configuration change, extension toggle, or other in-browser action). This classification follows the content of the maintainer’s resolution ( GT fix: version-type? in Figure 1 ). The Wrong Version issue is version-type by definition, and so are two external system issues whose maintainer resolved the report by pointing to a later release that contains an upstream Chromium fix; the remaining six issues are GUI-type. For a version-type fix, we provision a Docker container already running the newer, fixed Brave release ( Docker: newer / fixed version ). For a GUI-type fix, we provision a container running the version originally reported by the issue reporter ( Docker (reported version) ), and we apply the maintainer’s fix to it through the browser GUI. Either path yields the fixed state (green ellipse in Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个错误报告，我们将维护人员提供的真实修复方案归类为版本类型（即通过升级到更新的 Brave 版本即可解决该错误）或 GUI 类型（即通过配置更改、扩展程序切换或其他浏览器内操作解决该错误）。 这种分类依据是维护人员提供的修复内容（图 1 中的“真实修复：版本类型？”）。 “错误版本”问题按定义属于版本类型，另外两个外部系统问题也属于此类，因为维护人员通过指出包含上游 Chromium 修复的后续版本解决了这些报告；其余六个问题则属于 GUI 类型。 对于版本类型的修复，我们会提供一个已运行更新且经过修复的 Brave 版本的 Docker 容器（Docker：更新/修复后的版本）。 对于 GUI 类型的修复，我们会提供一个运行问题报告者最初所用版本的容器（Docker（报告版本）），并通过浏览器 GUI 应用维护人员的修复方案。 无论采用哪种路径，最终都会得到已修复的状态（图 1 中的绿色椭圆）。

sents.zh: 这种分类依据是维护人员提供的修复内容（图 1 中的“真实修复：版本类型？”）。

sents.en: For a version-type fix, we provision a Docker container already running the newer, fixed Brave release ( Docker: newer / fixed version ).
sents.zh: 对于版本类型的修复，我们会提供一个已运行更新且经过修复的 Brave 版本的 Docker 容器（Docker：更新/修复后的版本）。

paragraphs.en: Before rolling anything back, we verify that the fixed state is genuinely fixed: the steps-to-reproduce from the bug report are executed and checked against the report’s stated actual result ( Is bug reproduced? in Figure 1 ). If the actual result is not observed, this check passes and the pipeline continues to the rollback stage. If it is observed, the ground-truth fix as applied does not resolve the bug in our environment; the issue is dropped ( Drop issue ) and no further evaluation is attempted for it.
paragraphs.zh: 在回滚任何内容之前，我们会验证该固定状态是否确实已固定：执行故障报告中的复现步骤，并将其结果与报告中说明的实际结果（图 1 中的“是否复现了故障？”）进行核对。 如果未观察到实际结果，则此检查通过，流程将继续进入回滚阶段。 如果观察到了该结果，则所应用的基准修复方案并未解决我们环境中的故障；此时将放弃该问题（“放弃问题”），不再尝试对其进行进一步评估。

paragraphs.en: Once this check passes, the ground-truth fix is rolled back, branching again on whether it was version-type or GUI-type. For a version-type fix, we switch the Docker container back to the originally reported version ( Switch Docker: back to reported version ). For a GUI-type fix, a scripted sequence of GUI actions reverts the fix without changing the container version ( Revert fix (GUI) ). Either path returns the environment to the configuration that exhibited the bug before the fix, which we call the buggy state (red ellipse in Figure 1 ). The rollback confirms that the state the checker reads in the buggy environment corresponds to the reported symptom.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦此检查通过，真实情况修复将被回滚，并再次根据修复类型是版本类型还是 GUI 类型进行分支处理。 对于版本类型的修复，我们将 Docker 容器切换回最初报告的版本（切换 Docker：回到报告版本）。 对于 GUI 类型的修复，一个脚本化的 GUI 操作序列会撤销修复，而不会更改容器版本（撤销修复（GUI））。 无论选择哪条路径，环境都会恢复到修复前出现错误的配置状态，我们称之为错误状态（图 1 中的红色椭圆）。 此次回滚证实了检查器在错误环境中读取到的状态与报告的症状相对应。

sents.en: Once this check passes, the ground-truth fix is rolled back, branching again on whether it was version-type or GUI-type.
sents.zh: 一旦此检查通过，真实情况修复将被回滚，并再次根据修复类型是版本类型还是 GUI 类型进行分支处理。

sents.en: For a version-type fix, we switch the Docker container back to the originally reported version ( Switch Docker: back to reported version ).
sents.zh: 对于版本类型的修复，我们将 Docker 容器切换回最初报告的版本（切换 Docker：回到报告版本）。

sents.en: For a GUI-type fix, a scripted sequence of GUI actions reverts the fix without changing the container version ( Revert fix (GUI) ).
sents.zh: 对于 GUI 类型的修复，一个脚本化的 GUI 操作序列会撤销修复，而不会更改容器版本（撤销修复（GUI））。

sents.en: The rollback confirms that the state the checker reads in the buggy environment corresponds to the reported symptom.
sents.zh: 此次回滚证实了检查器在错误环境中读取到的状态与报告的症状相对应。

paragraphs.en: We now verify that the rollback actually produced the reported bug: the steps-to-reproduce are executed again and checked against the stated actual result (the second Is bug reproduced? check in Figure 1 ). If the actual result is observed, this check passes, and the issue proceeds to per-LLM evaluation. If not, the rollback failed to reproduce the bug, and the issue is dropped ( Drop issue ). Together, these two checks ensure that every issue carried into the LLM evaluation stage has a genuinely fixed reference state and a genuinely buggy state derived from it. Of the 51 selected issues, 38 could not be set up in our environment at all, for example because they were specific to a platform other than Linux or required a live backend service, and four did not exhibit the reported bug when tested; the remaining nine passed both checks and formed the effective evaluation set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在验证回滚操作确实产生了所报告的错误：再次执行复现步骤，并与声明的实际结果（图 1 中的第二个“是否复现了错误？”检查项）进行比对。 如果观察到了实际结果，则此检查通过，该问题将进入每个 LLM 的评估流程。 如果没有观察到，则回滚操作未能复现该错误，该问题将被放弃（放弃问题）。 这两项检查共同确保了每个进入 LLM 评估阶段的问题都拥有一个真正已修复的参考状态以及由此派生出的真正存在错误的状态。 在选定的 51 个问题中，有 38 个完全无法在我们的环境中设置起来，例如因为它们专用于 Linux 以外的平台或需要实时后端服务；另有 4 个在测试时未表现出所报告的错误；其余 9 个通过了两项检查，构成了实际的评估集合。

sents.zh: 在选定的 51 个问题中，有 38 个完全无法在我们的环境中设置起来，例如因为它们专用于 Linux 以外的平台或需要实时后端服务；另有 4 个在测试时未表现出所报告的错误；其余 9 个通过了两项检查，构成了实际的评估集合。

paragraphs.en: For each of the 36 candidate fixes (12 configurations, three independently generated runs each), every episode starts from a fresh container in the buggy state verified above ( Reset to buggy state ): for GUI-type issues, a fresh profile on the gate-verified build, with the buggy value pre-seeded where the bug is not Brave’s default state; for the version-type issues, the originally reported build. The executor then applies the LLM’s fix through the browser GUI ( Executor applies fix (GUI) ). On the version-type issues, a fix may instead call for an update: when the executor opens Brave’s update page ( brave://settings/help ), the harness switches the container to the fixed build ( Switch Docker in Figure 1 ), which is what a user would obtain by updating. Because the switch is triggered by the executor’s own action, resolution rates on these issues can differ across executors. After the episode, an issue-specific checker reads the resulting browser state and decides whether the reported actual result is still present; we additionally replay the steps-to-reproduce and keep the screenshots as a visual record ( Re-run steps-to-reproduce & verify ). This verdict is produced by the checker (Section 3.4 ). Each attempt therefore yields two independent signals: the checker’s verdict on whether the bug persists, and the executor’s own termination status (DONE, BLOCKED, step budget exhausted, or stopped without a verdict), which feed the metrics in Section 3.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 36 个候选修复方案中的每一个（12 种配置，每种配置独立运行三次），每一集都从上述已验证的带缺陷状态下的全新容器开始（重置为带缺陷状态）：对于 GUI 类型问题，使用通过网关验证构建的新个人资料，并在缺陷值处预置种子，因为该缺陷并非 Brave 的默认状态；而对于版本类型问题，则使用最初报告时所用的构建版本。 随后，执行器通过浏览器 GUI 应用 LLM 提供的修复方案（执行器应用修复方案（GUI））。 对于版本类型问题，修复方案可能反而会要求更新：当执行器打开 Brave 的更新页面（brave://settings/help）时，测试框架会将容器切换到已修复的构建版本（图 1 中的切换 Docker），这正是用户通过更新操作会获得的结果。 由于切换是由执行器自身的操作触发的，因此这些问题的解决率可能因执行器而异。 每一集结束后，一个针对特定问题的检查器会读取浏览器最终状态，并判断报告的实际结果是否仍然存在；此外，我们还会重新执行复现步骤，并保留截图作为视觉记录（重新运行复现步骤并进行验证）。 这一判定由检查器生成（第 3.4 节）。 因此，每次尝试都会产生两个独立的信号：检查器对缺陷是否持续的判定，以及执行器自身的终止状态（完成、受阻、步骤预算耗尽或未作出判定即停止），这两个信号将用于计算第 3.6 节中的指标。

sents.en: This verdict is produced by the checker (Section 3.4 ).
sents.zh: 这一判定由检查器生成（第 3.4 节）。

sents.en: Each attempt therefore yields two independent signals: the checker’s verdict on whether the bug persists, and the executor’s own termination status (DONE, BLOCKED, step budget exhausted, or stopped without a verdict), which feed the metrics in Section 3.6 .

paragraphs.en: To isolate variance introduced by the choice of executor from variance in the underlying LLM fix quality, we run the per-fix stage once with each of three executors. The three executors we compare are OpenCUA-72B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , an open-weight model trained for computer use; Meta’s Muse Glimmer ( Meta Superintelligence Labs, 2026 ) , an open-weight general-purpose agentic model; and Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) with its computer-use tool (bottom left side of Figure 1 ). All three act on the same browser environment through a shared action interface. OpenCUA and Sonnet 5 use the action formats defined by their developers, while Muse Glimmer, which has no official computer-use harness, is driven through a function-calling schema we designed; implementation details are provided in our replication package (Section 8 ). All three executors receive the same task prompt, containing the bug report and the fix text, and act for at most 20 steps per episode. Sonnet 5 uses its default sampling settings, OpenCUA-72B greedy decoding (temperature 0) as in its reference evaluation code, and Muse Glimmer temperature 1.0 and top- p p 0.95 as recommended by its model card 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B .

paragraphs.en: The executor applies a fix but does not decide whether the fix worked. For each issue, we implement a deterministic checker that reads the browser state tied to the reported symptom, such as a value in the browser’s preference files or a property of the rendered page queried through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, and reports whether the reported actual result is still present. The executor’s own claim of success is recorded but never used as the verdict. The checkers are the only issue-specific code in the pipeline and are part of our replication package.
paragraphs.zh: 执行者会应用修复方案，但不会判断该修复方案是否有效。 针对每个问题，我们都会实现一个确定性检查器：它读取与报告症状相关的浏览器状态（例如浏览器偏好文件中的某个值，或通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 查询的已渲染页面的某个属性），并报告报告的实际结果是否仍然存在。 执行者自身声称成功的结果会被记录，但绝不会被用作最终判定。 这些检查器是流程中唯一针对特定问题的代码，也是我们复现包的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Because executor behavior is stochastic, each fix is executed three times by each executor. We count a fix as resolved under an executor if the checker reports the bug as absent in at least one of the three runs. The fix text is identical across runs, so if the checker finds the bug absent after any run, following the fix’s instructions can remove the bug; a run in which the same fix fails may instead reflect an executor error. We therefore treat one successful run as sufficient, an assumption that RQ3 tests against human execution. We count a fix as non-applicable under an executor if the executor declared it BLOCKED in at least two of the three runs.
paragraphs.zh: 由于执行者的行为具有随机性，每个修复方案都会被每个执行者执行三次。 如果检查器在三次运行中至少有一次报告不存在该问题，我们就认为该修复方案在该执行者处已解决。 修复文本在所有运行中均相同，因此只要检查器在任何一次运行后未发现该问题，遵循修复方案的说明即可消除问题；而同一修复方案未能成功运行的情况，则可能反映的是执行者的错误。 因此，我们认为一次成功运行即足够，这一假设将在 RQ3 中通过与人类执行结果的对比进行检验。 如果执行者在三次运行中至少两次声明该修复方案为“受阻”，我们就认为该修复方案在该执行者处不适用。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline’s verdicts depend on the executors correctly applying LLM-generated fixes and correctly observing whether the reported bug persists afterwards. To measure how reliably they do this, we compare the executors against humans performing the same task manually.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程的裁决取决于执行者能否正确应用由大型语言模型生成的修复方案，并准确观察到所报告的缺陷在修复后是否仍然存在。 为了衡量他们执行这一过程的可靠性，我们将执行者与手动完成相同任务的人类进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We draw a simple random sample of 75 of the 322 individual fixes in the evaluation set, using a fixed random seed. This sample size yields a 95% confidence level with a margin of error of ± 10 % \pm 10\% for proportions estimated over the population of 322 fixes, following Cochran’s formula with finite population correction ( Cochran, 1977 ) and assuming maximum variability ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ). For each sampled fix, the buggy state is reproduced identically to how the executors experience it: a fresh Brave environment with the ground-truth fix rolled back. A human then executes the LLM’s fix on this environment literally, performing the actions the fix describes without judging their correctness. The human then runs the steps-to-reproduce and records whether the reported actual result is observed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用固定的随机种子，从评估集中的 322 个独立修复中抽取一个包含 75 个样本的简单随机样本。 根据 Cochran 公式并考虑有限总体校正（Cochran, 1977），同时假设最大变异性（p = 0.5），该样本量在 322 个修复的总体中估算出的比例具有 95% 的置信水平和 ±10% 的误差范围。 对于每个被抽样的修复，其错误状态都会被完全按照执行者所经历的方式重现：即使用一个全新的 Brave 环境，并将真实修复回滚。 随后，一名人类会严格按照该环境执行 LLM 提供的修复，完成修复中描述的操作，而不对这些操作的正确性进行判断。 接着，这名人类会运行复现步骤，并记录是否观察到报告中的实际结果。

paragraphs.en: Because the browser state determines the outcome, the comparison does not rest on subjective agreement. If the executor and the human executed the same fix on the same starting state, both should in principle arrive at the same outcome. A divergence may reflect an executor or checker error, an ambiguous fix that admits more than one reasonable reading, or an imperfect human execution, so we treat the human outcome as a reference rather than a ground truth. We compare each executor’s resolved verdict with the human outcome and report the percentage of matching fixes, with 95% Wilson ( Wilson, 1927 ) confidence intervals, as the accuracy of that executor.
paragraphs.zh: 由于浏览器状态决定了最终结果，因此这种比较并不依赖于主观上的认同。 如果执行者和人类在相同的初始状态下执行了相同的修复方案，那么原则上两者都应该得到相同的结果。 结果的差异可能反映出执行者或检查者的错误、存在多种合理解释的模糊修复方案，或是人类执行过程中的不完美之处，因此我们将人类的结果视为参考，而非绝对标准。 我们将每位执行者得出的最终判定与人类的结果进行比较，并报告匹配修复方案的百分比以及 95% 的威尔逊（Wilson, 1927）置信区间，以此作为该执行者的准确率。

paragraphs.en: We report the following metrics computed over the outcomes produced by the pipeline:

paragraphs.en: Resolution rate: For each (configuration, executor) pair, the fraction of the configuration’s individual fixes (27 fixes for 11 configurations and 25 for Agentic-Kimi) that the executor resolved, as defined in Section 3.4 . Aggregated across all 12 configurations, this yields a resolution rate over the 322 fixes per executor. This fix-level rate, rather than an issue-level one, is the primary measure of fix quality in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 解决率：对于每一对（配置，执行器），执行器解决了该配置中单个修复项的比例（11 个配置中有 27 个修复项，Agentic-Kimi 有 25 个），具体定义见第 3.4 节。 在所有 12 个配置中汇总后，得出每个执行器对 322 个修复项的解决率。 本文衡量修复质量的主要指标是这一修复级别的解决率，而非问题级别的解决率。

This separates fixes the executor judged non-actionable (advice, requests for information, deferrals) from applied fixes that failed to resolve the bug. Because it relies on the executor’s judgment, applicability is reported per executor.
paragraphs.zh: 适用率：执行器在其大多数运行中未声明为“受阻”的修复方案所占的比例，无论该问题最终是否得到解决。 这将执行器判断为无法采取行动的修复方案（建议、信息请求、推迟处理）与未能解决问题的已应用修复方案区分开来。 由于适用率依赖于执行器的判断，因此该指标按执行器分别报告。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports the pass counts of each individual executor run and the number of fixes resolved in at least one run. Within an executor, the pass rate varied by at most 3.4% across runs (Sonnet 5, 38.8% to 42.2%), while Muse Glimmer trailed the other two executors by at least 20.5 points in every run. All three runs reached the same verdict for 92.2% of fixes under Muse Glimmer, 82.3% under Sonnet 5, and 73.9% under OpenCUA-72B. Counting a fix as resolved if any run passed added 24 fixes over the best single run for Sonnet 5 (160 against 136), 38 for OpenCUA-72B (147 against 109), and 12 for Muse Glimmer (47 against 35). Under a majority vote the rates were 39.8%, 30.7%, and 9.9%, so Sonnet 5 leads OpenCUA-72B under both aggregation rules.

paragraphs.en: All three executors reached the same verdict on 46.9% of fixes. Sonnet 5 and OpenCUA-72B agreed on 62.4% of fixes (Cohen’s κ = 0.25 \kappa=0.25 ), Sonnet 5 and Muse Glimmer on 64.3% ( κ = 0.28 \kappa=0.28 ), and OpenCUA-72B and Muse Glimmer on 67.1% ( κ = 0.30 \kappa=0.30 ). The ranking of the 12 configurations was only weakly preserved: Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} was 0.13 between Sonnet 5 and OpenCUA-72B, 0.45 between Sonnet 5 and Muse Glimmer, and 0.05 between OpenCUA-72B and Muse Glimmer. paragraphs.en: RQ2 shows that an executor-based evaluation does not measure fix quality in isolation. The same 322 fixes produced resolution rates between 14.6% and 49.7%, and the rate of a single configuration moved by 38.8% on average when only the executor changed. These gaps are much larger than the run-to-run variation within any executor (at most 3.4 points), so they reflect systematic properties of the executors rather than noise. Conclusions about which LLM produces better no-code fixes are therefore conditional on the executor. Even the strongest configuration was not stable: V-Claude led under Sonnet 5 but ranked third under OpenCUA-72B and second under Muse Glimmer, and the rankings of the 12 configurations were nearly unrelated between Sonnet 5 and OpenCUA-72B ( τ b = 0.13 \tau_{b}=0.13 ) and between OpenCUA-72B and Muse Glimmer ( τ b = 0.05 \tau_{b}=0.05 ). Some comparisons changed substantially: RAG-Kimi resolved 22.3% more fixes than V-Kimi under OpenCUA-72B (55.6% against 33.3%) and exactly as many under Sonnet 5.

paragraphs.en: The executors also differed in where they succeeded. OpenCUA-72B resolved every fix for issue 37372 6 6 6 https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/37372 , whose checker is lenient (Section 6 ), while Sonnet 5 resolved 20 of 36, whereas Sonnet 5 was the only executor to resolve any fix for issue 24747 7 7 7 https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/24747 . Muse Glimmer exhausted its step budget in 55.1% of its episodes and resolved no fix for four of the nine issues. No single executor is thus a neutral instrument, and a verdict of “fix failed” can mean that the executor failed. We draw three practical implications for execution-based evaluation with agentic executors. First, the executor and its harness should be reported as part of the experimental setup, in the same way as the model under evaluation. Second, results should be obtained with more than one executor or calibrated against human execution, as we do in RQ3. Third, run-level results and the aggregation rule should be reported, because the rule interacts with executor stability: counting a fix as resolved if any run passed added 38 fixes over the best single run for OpenCUA-72B, the least stable executor, but only 12 to 24 for the other two.

paragraphs.en: The executors’ termination status also shows why the verdict should not be left to the executor. An executor reports DONE when it believes it has applied the fix, not when the bug is gone, and the two diverge in both directions: the checker found the bug resolved in only 621 of the 1,146 episodes that ended in DONE, while 162 of the 1,077 episodes that ran out of steps nevertheless left the browser in a resolved state. On the version-dependent issues alone, Sonnet 5, OpenCUA-72B, and Muse Glimmer said DONE while the checker failed in 7, 121, and 1 of 324 episodes, and the checker passed without a DONE report in 54, 38, and 26. Using the agent’s own completion signal as the outcome would therefore both inflate and deflate the measured capability, which is consistent with the observation of Hong et al. ( Hong et al., 2026 ) that GUI agents often misattribute their own execution failures. Separating the executor from an independent checker keeps the verdict reproducible, at the cost of per-issue setup and checker code (Section 6 ).

paragraphs.en: As argued in Section 1 reference-based metrics cannot show whether a no-code fix works. Our execution results allow a first look at this claim. For each LLM-generated fix, we took the BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) value against the maintainer’s ground-truth fix released in the replication package of Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) , and examined the 108 fixes that failed in all nine attempts, that is, in every run under every executor. Because no executor resolved these fixes, their failure does not depend on the executor sensitivity discussed in Section 5.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 正如第 1 节中所论证的，基于参考的指标无法判断无代码修复是否有效。我们的执行结果首次验证了这一论断。对于每个由 LLM 生成的修复方案，我们计算了其与 Gön et al.（Gon et al., 2026）在复现包中发布的维护者基准修复方案之间的 BERTScore（Zhang et al., 2019）值，并检查了那 108 个在所有九次尝试中均失败的修复方案，即每个执行器下的每次运行中均失败。由于没有任何执行器能够解决这些修复方案，因此它们的失败并不取决于第 5.1 节中讨论的执行器敏感性。

paragraphs.en: These fixes received BERTScore F1 values between 0.757 and 0.867 (median 0.831), within or above the range of 0.81 to 0.82 that Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) report for fixes across their benchmark. A fix that never removed the reported symptom was thus scored as close to the maintainer’s resolution as a typical fix. The 214 fixes that at least one executor resolved scored the same (median 0.832, mean 0.824 against 0.823). Scores also varied far more between issues than within them. Fixes for issue 25379 averaged 0.762, while those for every other issue with such fixes averaged between 0.818 and 0.846 (issue 37372 has none, because OpenCUA-72B resolved all its fixes), which suggests that the score reflects the wording of the reference resolution more than the correctness of the fix. A single BERTScore threshold therefore cannot separate working from failing fixes across issues, and a comparison of configurations by BERTScore partly reflects which issues their fixes belong to.

paragraphs.en: Even under the executor with the highest resolution rate and the highest agreement with the humans (Sonnet 5, 49.7%), just under half of the LLM-generated fixes resolved the reported bug (39.8% under a majority vote), and the best configuration reached 74.1%. Automatically generated no-code fixes are therefore not yet reliable enough to be sent to reporters without review, although the best configurations resolve a majority of cases under two of the three executors. No configuration led under every executor. V-Claude, which also had the highest applicability under Sonnet 5 (88.9%), and Agentic-Gemini were the only configurations in the top three under all three executors, but the intervals overlap heavily, so we do not claim a robust winner. The pipeline enhancements proposed by Gön et al. ( Gon et al., 2026 ) did not translate into consistent gains: for Gemini, RAG resolved fewer fixes than Vanilla under OpenCUA-72B and Muse Glimmer but more under Sonnet 5, whereas for Kimi neither RAG nor Agentic web search resolved fewer fixes than Vanilla under Sonnet 5 or OpenCUA-72B. Agentic web search had the highest rate for both backbones under Sonnet 5 and Muse Glimmer, but not for Kimi under OpenCUA-72B.

paragraphs.en: Applicability and resolution capture different ways in which a fix can fail. A configuration can fail by not proposing an executable action, as V-MiniMax did for almost half of its fixes under Sonnet 5, or by proposing an action that does not remove the symptom. The two failure modes call for different remedies: the first concerns the model’s willingness to commit to a concrete instruction, the second its knowledge of the application. At the same time, applicability as measured here depends on the executor, since OpenCUA-72B rarely declared any fix non-applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 适用性与解决性分别捕捉了修复可能失败的两种不同方式。 一种配置可能因未能提出可执行的操作而失败，正如 V-MiniMax 在 Sonnet 5 测试中对其近一半修复所做的那样；也可能因提出的操作无法消除症状而失败。 这两种失败模式需要不同的应对方法：前者涉及模型是否愿意执行具体指令，后者则与其对应用的了解有关。 同时，此处所衡量的适用性取决于执行者，因为 OpenCUA-72B 很少将任何修复判定为不适用。

paragraphs.en: The reduction from 302 annotated reports to 51 candidates and finally to nine executable issues is worth reading as a finding rather than merely as a description of our sample. Bug reports resolved without a code change are only part of what an issue tracker receives ( Aktas et al., 2023 ; Erfani Joorabchi et al., 2014 ) , and only a subset of those are resolved by an action that can be carried out in an environment at all; the remainder are answered with an explanation, a request for further information, or a decision that the reported behavior is intended ( Erfani Joorabchi et al., 2014 ) (Section 3.1 ). What makes such reports costly to collect is that this distinction leaves no structural trace. Issue trackers do not label invalid reports as such, and their resolutions are not linked to commits, so there is no signal analogous to a fixing commit that can be mined automatically, as is routinely done when constructing code-level benchmarks. Identifying a no-code fix requires reading the maintainer discussion of a closed issue and judging what the resolution consisted of. Any effort to scale execution-based evaluation of no-code fixes will therefore have to confront dataset construction as a research problem in its own right, most plausibly by automating the recognition of no-code resolutions in maintainer comments.

paragraphs.en: The reduction observed before and at the sanity gates is informative for a second reason. Of the 51 candidates, 38 could not be set up in a Linux browser environment at all, because they depended on another platform, a live backend, or information the report did not provide ( Bruno et al., 2026 ) , and 4 more did not exhibit the reported bug when tested. These are reports whose resolution was accepted by both the reporter and the maintainer, yet whose bug-fix pair could not be re-established outside the original reporting context. This suggests that no-code bugs are frequently entangled with state that the report does not capture, such as an accumulated user profile, a particular operating system or hardware configuration, the behavior of a third-party service at the time of reporting, or a server-side change that no local rollback can undo. Seen this way, the gates are not only a filter that reduced our evaluation set but a measurement instrument: they quantify how often a documented no-code fix can be independently re-executed at all, which is a precondition that any execution-based evaluation of this task, ours or otherwise, must satisfy. We consequently kept them strict, on the view that a verdict grounded in a verified buggy state and a verified fixed state carries more evidential weight than a larger set of verdicts resting on unchecked assumptions about the environment. Threats arising from the resulting set size are discussed in Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 在合理性检查门之前和检查门处观察到的减少现象，从第二个原因来看也具有启发性。 在 51 个候选项中，有 38 个根本无法在 Linux 浏览器环境中设置，因为它们依赖于其他平台、实时后端或报告中未提供的信息（Bruno 等，2026），另有 4 个在测试时并未表现出报告中所描述的缺陷。 这些是解决结果同时得到了报告者和维护者认可的报告，但其缺陷修复对却无法在原报告上下文之外重新建立。 这表明，无代码缺陷常常与报告中未记录的状态相互交织，例如累积的用户资料、特定的操作系统或硬件配置、报告时第三方服务的行为，或是任何本地回滚都无法撤销的服务器端变更。 从这个角度看，这些门不仅是缩小了我们评估集的一个过滤器，更是一种测量工具：它们量化了已记录的无代码修复方案能够被独立重新执行的比例，而这正是任何基于执行的评估——无论是我们的还是其他评估——都必须满足的前提条件。 因此，我们坚持采用严格的判断标准，因为我们认为，基于经验证的有缺陷状态和经验证的修复状态所作出的判断，比基于对环境未经检验的假设而得出的更大规模的判断集合更具证据效力。 由此产生的集合规模所带来的威胁将在第 6 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: Every verdict in our study depends on an executor carrying out a natural-language fix in a real browser. An executor may misapply a fix, apply it only partially, or change unrelated state, in which case a failed fix says nothing about the fix itself. The 20-step budget adds a related threat: an episode that is cut off may have succeeded with more steps, which matters most for Muse Glimmer, whose episodes exhausted the budget in 55.1% of cases. To reduce the effect of individual execution failures, we executed every fix three times per executor and counted a fix as resolved if any run succeeded, and we compare executor outcomes with human execution on a random sample of fixes. Executors could also act outside the browser: the container desktop offers a shell, and 10 OpenCUA-72B episodes typed shell-like commands. Nine of them failed without an update and one passed through the settings-page update, so no resolved episode depended on a shell.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究中的每一项裁决都取决于执行者在真实浏览器中执行自然语言修复。 执行者可能错误应用修复、仅部分应用修复，或改变无关状态；在这种情况下，修复失败并不能说明修复本身存在问题。 20步预算引入了一个相关威胁：被截断的流程本可能在更多步骤下成功，这对 Muse Glimmer 尤为重要，因为 55.1% 的情况下其流程用尽了预算。 为减少单次执行失败的影响，我们对每个修复由每位执行者执行三次，只要有一次运行成功即视为修复已解决；同时，我们将执行者的结果与人类在随机抽取的修复样本上的执行结果进行比较。 执行者也可能在浏览器之外操作：容器桌面提供了一个外壳环境，且有 10 个 OpenCUA-72B 流程输入了类似外壳的命令。 其中九个流程因未更新而失败，一个通过设置页面的更新成功，因此没有哪个成功的流程依赖于外壳操作。

paragraphs.en: The three executors could not be driven by an identical harness. Sonnet 5 used its native computer-use tool, OpenCUA-72B used its own action format with the screenshot history window of its reference harness, and Muse Glimmer, which has no official computer-use harness, was driven through a function-calling schema that we designed. The executors also used different sampling settings (Section 3.4 ), which we did not tune. A higher temperature yields more varied runs and thus benefits more from counting a fix as resolved if any of three runs succeeds. Differences between executors may therefore partly stem from their harnesses and sampling settings, and our own schema may disadvantage Muse Glimmer. We kept the task prompt, the step budget, and the environment identical across executors, and we interpret RQ2 as a comparison of executors together with their harnesses rather than of the underlying models alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个执行器无法由完全相同的约束框架驱动。 Sonnet 5 使用了其原生的计算机使用工具，OpenCUA-72B 则使用其自身的动作格式，并结合参考约束框架的截图历史窗口；而 Muse Glimmer 没有官方的计算机使用约束框架，因此我们通过我们设计的函数调用方案来驱动它。 这些执行器还使用了不同的采样设置（第 3.4 节），而这些设置我们没有进行调优。 更高的温度会产生更多样化的运行结果，因此如果三次运行中有一次成功，就更有可能将某个修复视为已解决。 因此，执行器之间的差异可能部分源于它们的约束框架和采样设置，而我们自己的方案可能对 Muse Glimmer 不利。 我们在所有执行器中保持了任务提示、步骤预算和环境的一致性，并将 RQ2 解释为对执行器及其约束框架的综合比较，而非仅比较其底层模型。

paragraphs.en: Whether a fix resolves the bug is decided by an issue-specific checker that reads the browser state tied to the symptom in the bug report, such as a preference value or a property of the rendered page. A checker may accept a state that was reached without addressing the reported problem, or reject a valid fix that removes the symptom through a different route. paragraphs.en: Two of our metrics involve design choices that affect the reported values. paragraphs.en: The human executors in RQ3 are the first two authors. Their familiarity with the pipeline, and in some cases with a bug’s ground-truth resolution, may influence how they execute a fix. We blinded both executors to the configuration that generated each fix and to the executors’ outcomes, and had both execute every sampled fix independently. Their agreement was moderate (78.7%, κ = 0.54 \kappa=0.54 ), and the second human resolved more fixes than the first (29 against 25), so the human outcome is a reference rather than a validated ground truth. paragraphs.en: We presented a rollback-based, automated execution-driven pipeline that verifies LLM-generated no-code fixes by applying them with an executor in a real browser and checking the resulting state. Applied to 322 fixes from 12 LLM-based configurations on nine reproducible Brave bug reports, the pipeline shows that current LLMs resolve between 14.6% and 49.7% of the reported bugs depending on the executor, with V-Claude the strongest configuration under Sonnet 5 but not under the other two executors. The choice of executor shifted the measured capability of a configuration by 38.8% on average and only weakly preserved configuration rankings, which makes the executor a first-order variable in any execution-based evaluation of this kind. Only nine of 51 candidate reports could be re-established in a controlled environment, so scaling this form of evaluation will require automated construction of executable no-code benchmarks. Compared with human execution on a random sample, Sonnet 5 was the most accurate executor (88.1% agreement with the human consensus), whereas OpenCUA-72B overstated resolution and agreed on 66.1%. Future work will extend the pipeline to more applications and bug types, and study how executor harnesses can be standardized so that verdicts become comparable across executors.

sents.zh: 与随机样本中的人工执行结果相比，Sonnet 5 是最准确的执行器（与人类共识一致率达 88.1%），而 OpenCUA-72B 则高估了修复成功率，一致率仅为 66.1%。

sents.en: Future work will extend the pipeline to more applications and bug types, and study how executor harnesses can be standardized so that verdicts become comparable across executors.
sents.zh: 未来工作将把该流程扩展到更多应用场景和错误类型，并研究如何标准化执行器框架，以实现不同执行器之间评估结果的相互比较。

paragraphs.en: Our replication package is available at https://figshare.com/s/eda4e478ccbf242fbdab . It contains the Dockerfile and build scripts for the pinned Brave builds of the evaluated issues, the per-issue environment setup (profile seeds and scripted gate actions), the issue-specific checkers, the executor prompts and action interfaces (including our function-calling schema for Muse Glimmer), the verdicts of executor episodes and the text traces of them, the 322 evaluated fix texts, the human verdicts and sampling seed for RQ3, the status of all 51 candidate issues with the reason each excluded issue was dropped, and the scripts that produce every table, including the majority-vote variants.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的复现包可在 https://figshare.com/s/eda4e478ccbf242fbdab 获取。 其中包含用于已固定版本 Brave 构建的评估问题的 Dockerfile 和构建脚本、每个问题的环境设置（配置文件种子和脚本化门控操作）、问题特定的检查器、执行器提示和操作接口（包括我们为 Muse Glimmer 设计的函数调用方案）、执行器回合的判断结果及其文本追踪、322 篇经过评估的修复文本、人类判断结果以及 RQ3 的采样种子、全部 51 个候选问题的状态及每个被排除问题的原因，以及生成每张表格（包括多数投票变体）的脚本。
